title: On the set of orthogonal positive sums in a $C^*$-algebra
summary: For a $C^*$-algebra $A$ let $\mathcal I(A)$ be the set of all elements $a+b$ with $a,b\in A_+$, $ab=0$ and $\|a\|=\|b\|=1$. We study the algebraic, metric and topological properties of $\mathcal I(A)$. We describe $\mathcal I(A\oplus B)$ and show that $\mathcal I(A/J)\subseteqπ(\mathcal I(A))$ for the quotient map $π:A\to A/J$. For finite-dimensional $A$ we prove $\mathcal I(A)=\operatorname{Sph}^+_A(E(A))$, where $E(A)$ is the set of minimal projections of $A$ and $\operatorname{Sph}^+_A(E)$ is the set of positive norm-one elements at distance one from every element of $E$; we also show…
